# 2026-11-19 v6.4 D4-1 phase 2 (Alexandria, Smyrna's fall, Varna and the Hexamilion: events 4, 8-12, 14; world steps W-1 to W-3) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 17); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): close in 1525, bookkeeping, then at most one event in a calm, free month.
oe_lat_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_off } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1525.1.1 } set_variable = oe_lat_off }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            oe_lat_book = yes
            oe_lat_world = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_lat_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 13 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 2 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 3 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_8 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 8 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_7 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 7 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 5 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_12 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 12 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_10 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 10 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_9 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_9 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 9 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 4 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 1 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_21 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 21 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_20 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 20 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_24 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 24 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_30 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 30 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 13 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 13 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 2 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 2 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 3 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 3 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 8 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_8 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 8 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 7 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 7 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_5 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 5 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_12 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 12 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 10 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_10 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 10 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 9 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_9 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 9 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_4 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 4 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_1 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 21 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_21 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 21 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 20 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_20 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 20 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 24 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_24 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 24 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 30 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_30 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 30 } }
                remove_variable = oe_lat_pick
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends an event of the monthly check (the one-off events .1 .5 are marked fired just before, above).
oe_lat_fire = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_st value = $n$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.$n$
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Bookkeeping, no pop-ups (design 3.3, phase-1 part).
oe_lat_book = {
    # The crusade: its target and temporal leader are recorded once; when it is gone, a crusade we helped opens the
    # buy-back window of .3 (10 years) and the line forgets it.
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:crusade }
        international_organization:crusade = {
            international_organization_target ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_bt }
            random_country_with_special_status_of_type = { type = crusade_temporal_leader save_scope_as = oe_lat_bl }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_cru_t } exists = scope:oe_lat_bt } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_cru_t value = scope:oe_lat_bt } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_cru_l } exists = scope:oe_lat_bl } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_cru_l value = scope:oe_lat_bl } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_lat_cru_t has_variable = oe_lat_cru_seen has_variable = oe_lat_cru_side } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_cru_side ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_handback years = 10 } }
        debug_log = "oe_lat crusade over: side [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_cru')|0], places kept [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_held')|0]"
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_t
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_l
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_seen
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_side
    }
    # Places left behind by a crusade: the window closes when none is still kept; the list is cleared when no crusade
    # runs and no window is open.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_handback NOT = { oe_lat_any_kept = yes } } remove_variable = oe_lat_handback }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable_list = oe_lat_held NOT = { exists = international_organization:crusade } NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_handback } }
        oe_lat_clear_held = yes
    }
    # Smyrna in Latin hands (the vanilla Smyrniote crusade, or anyone Catholic): recorded for .1.
    # Phase 2: lost to a non-Christian afterwards (not by W-1): oe_lat_smyrna_fell = 2, the month in oe_lat_smyrna_at (.8).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin } location:smyrna = { owner ?= { religion = religion:catholic } } }
        set_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell }
            location:smyrna = { owner ?= { NOT = { religion.group = religion_group:christian } } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_fell value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_at value = var:oe_lat_m }
        debug_log = "oe_lat: Smyrna lost by the Latins (2)"
    }
    # The Morea in the Knights' keeping: months counted; closed silently in 1410 or when the Knights are gone, and five
    # years after .7 c.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_morea ?= 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea_m add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_morea ?= 1 OR = { current_date >= 1410.1.1 NOT = { country_exists = c:KNI } } }
        oe_lat_morea_end = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_morea ?= 4 NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_morea_ext } } oe_lat_morea_end = yes }
    # Phase 2. Varna: months since the bull (until the Straits), since the defeat (until .12); W-2's wait after Nicopolis.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna_m NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_m add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_hex_m NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_hex_m add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_nic_m } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_m add = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_m value = 0 } }
    }
    # Phase 2. Events that can no longer come: .4 and .8 24 months after their news, .10 and .12 from 1449.1.1; the
    # Varna events are void when the bull's window closes without the premise (before .9 is marked given up below).
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_4 } oe_lat_alex_seen = yes var:oe_lat_m > oe_lat_alex_end } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_8 } has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell var:oe_lat_m > oe_lat_smyrna_end } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_10 } current_date >= 1449.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_hex_m NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } current_date >= 1449.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_12 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_9 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna_void } var:oe_lat_m > 1320 NOT = { oe_lat_varna_pre = yes } }
        set_variable = oe_lat_varna_void
        debug_log = "oe_lat: the Varna events are void (the Ottomans are not strong enough, or the City is lost)"
    }
    # Windows that passed without their event.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_1 } var:oe_lat_m > 192 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_5 } var:oe_lat_m > 804 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_9 } var:oe_lat_m > 1320 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_30 } var:oe_lat_m > 589 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_30 value = 2 } }
    # Phase 3. Vanilla's Western Schism seen running (global oe_lat_schism_seen: .21 waits for its end); once it is over,
    # .20 has passed if it never came, and .21 is void when the Papal States are gone. The envoys of .21 go to the
    # council from 1416.1.1. The crusade the pope called on our appeal is forgotten once it is over. An appeal whose
    # Papal States are gone before they answer is dropped (else the action would stay shut after its cooldown).
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_schism_seen } is_situation_active = situation:western_schism } set_global_variable = oe_lat_schism_seen }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait NOT = { country_exists = c:PAP } } remove_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_schism_seen NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:western_schism } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_20 } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_20 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_21 } NOT = { country_exists = c:PAP } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_21 value = 2 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_envoys_due current_date >= 1416.1.1 } remove_variable = oe_lat_envoys_due oe_lat_envoys_go = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_crusade_ours NOT = { exists = international_organization:crusade } } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_crusade_ours }
    # Phase 4. .24 is missable: given up when its window closes (1443.1.1) without it.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_24 } current_date >= 1443.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_24 value = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay / gain $months$ months of trade and tax income; pay them to c:$who$ (who gets the same gold).
oe_lat_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_lat_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
oe_lat_pay_to = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_m$months$ }
    add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 }
    c:$who$ ?= { add_gold = scope:oe_lat_amt }
}
# BYZ scope. .1: the choice on the Holy League ($v$: 1 member, 2 the old pact with the Turks, 0 trade only). oe_lat_league
# lasts 10 years (oe_lat_west_will reads it); oe_lat_league_was keeps the choice for the chronicle.
oe_lat_set_league = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_league value = $v$ years = 10 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_league_was value = $v$ }
}

# BYZ scope. The Peloponnese (theme region 14): every place of ours and of our subjects there.
oe_lat_morea_mod = {
    every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace } }
    every_subject = { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace } } }
}
oe_lat_morea_clear = {
    every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } oe_lat_morea_unmod = yes }
    every_subject = { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } oe_lat_morea_unmod = yes } }
}
# Location scope.
oe_lat_morea_unmod = {
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_lat_knights_morea } remove_location_modifier = oe_lat_knights_morea }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_lat_mistra_unrest } remove_location_modifier = oe_lat_mistra_unrest }
}
# BYZ scope. The Morea comes back from the Knights (.7 a/b, or silently in 1410, without the Knights, after .7 c).
oe_lat_morea_end = {
    oe_lat_morea_clear = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 2 }
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea_m
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea_ext
    debug_log = "oe_lat morea: back from the Knights"
}

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_lat.90 (var:oe_lat_do): 1 mark the crusaders (.2 a), 2 join the crusade (.2 d),
# 3 buy back (.3 a), 4 claim (.3 b), 5 leave them (.3 c), 6 the Knights take the Morea (.5 a), 7 bought back early
# (.6 a), 8 wait (.6 b), 9 enforce (.6 c), 10 redeemed (.7 a b), 11 five more years (.7 c), 12 refused (.5 c).
# Phase 2: 13 the Straits and the Morea (.9 a), 14 withdraw and pay (.12 a), 15 the wall falls (.14), 16 tribute (.12 c).
oe_lat_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 1 } oe_lat_mark_crusaders = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 2 } oe_lat_join_crusade = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 3 } oe_lat_buy_back = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 4 } oe_lat_reclaim = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 5 } oe_lat_bulwark = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 6 } oe_lat_morea_entrust = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 7 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 15 }
        oe_lat_morea_end = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 8 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -5 }
        location:mystras = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_lat_mistra_unrest years = 3 mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 9 } oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -15 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 10 } oe_lat_morea_end = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 11 }
        oe_lat_morea_mod = { mod = oe_lat_knights_morea years = 5 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea_ext years = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 12 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 13 }
        oe_lat_athens_cb = yes
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 5 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 14 } oe_lat_athens_cb_off = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 15 } oe_lat_hexamilion_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 16 } oe_lat_tribute = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_lat_do
}
# BYZ scope. .2 a: the members of the crusade are marked as crusaders for 15 years (on_action oe_lat_took_location).
oe_lat_mark_crusaders = {
    international_organization:crusade ?= {
        every_international_organization_member = { limit = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_crusader years = 15 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2 d: a Catholic empire joins the crusade.
oe_lat_join_crusade = {
    international_organization:crusade ?= { add_country_to_international_organization = c:BYZ }
    oe_lat_mark_crusaders = yes
}
# Location scope. Marks this place as left behind by the crusade, held by $who$.
oe_lat_mark = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_holder value = $who$ }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = oe_lat_held target = this } } }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = oe_lat_held target = this }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_lat_h set. Every listed place recorded for that holder leaves the list.
oe_lat_unmark = {
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = oe_lat_held
        limit = { var:oe_lat_holder ?= scope:oe_lat_h }
        remove_variable = oe_lat_holder
        add_to_temporary_list = oe_lat_drop
    }
    every_in_list = { list = oe_lat_drop remove_list_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_held target = this } }
}
# BYZ scope. Every listed place leaves the list.
oe_lat_clear_held = {
    every_in_global_list = { variable = oe_lat_held limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_holder } remove_variable = oe_lat_holder }
    clear_global_variable_list = oe_lat_held
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_lat_h set (.3 immediate). How many places that holder keeps, for the text.
oe_lat_count_h = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_h_n value = 0 }
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = oe_lat_held
        limit = { oe_lat_held_ok = yes var:oe_lat_holder ?= scope:oe_lat_h }
        root = { change_variable = { name = oe_lat_h_n add = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 a: buy back, nearest first, up to three places, two months of income each while the money lasts.
oe_lat_buy_back = {
    var:oe_lat_h ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_h }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_h }
        ordered_in_global_list = {
            variable = oe_lat_held
            limit = { oe_lat_held_ok = yes var:oe_lat_holder ?= scope:oe_lat_h }
            order_by = oe_lat_near
            max = 3
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { oe_lat_can_pay = { months = 2 } } }
                root = { oe_lat_pay = { months = 2 } }
                change_location_owner = root
                add_core = root
            }
        }
        scope:oe_lat_h = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_bought target = root } }
        oe_lat_unmark = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 b: a casus belli to restore the Roman borders against the holder.
oe_lat_reclaim = {
    var:oe_lat_h ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_h }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_h }
        add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_lat_h type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders years = 10 }
        scope:oe_lat_h = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_reclaim target = root } }
        oe_lat_unmark = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 c: the Latins keep them.
oe_lat_bulwark = {
    var:oe_lat_h ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_h }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_h }
        scope:oe_lat_h = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_bulwark target = root } }
        oe_lat_unmark = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .5 a: the Knights take the Morea in trust. No change of owner (decision 160): their garrison is a location
# modifier for 5 years, theme loyalty -10. An AI KNI pays four months of our income, at most what it has; a player KNI
# is not charged. .6 follows in 120-360 days.
oe_lat_morea_entrust = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KNI c:KNI = { is_ai = yes } }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_kni_price }
        c:KNI = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 } }
        add_gold = scope:oe_lat_amt
    }
    else = { oe_lat_gain = { months = 4 } }
    oe_lat_morea_mod = { mod = oe_lat_knights_morea years = 5 }
    oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -10 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea_m value = 0 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_lat.6 days = { 120 360 } }
    debug_log = "oe_lat morea: entrusted to the Knights"
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs); phase 2 adds a second line.
oe_lat_log = { debug_log = "oe_lat will=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_west_will')|0] league=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_league')|0] cru=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_cru')|0] held=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_held')|0] morea=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_morea')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_morea_m')|0] f1=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_f1')|0] f5=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_f5')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_st')|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_flags')|0]" oe_lat_log2 = yes }
oe_lat_log2 = { debug_log = "oe_lat2 varna=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_varna')|0] vres=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_vres')|0] vm=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_v_m')|0] hex=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_hex')|0] ev2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_ev2')|0] world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_world_flags')|0] straits%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_straits_chance')|0] varna%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_varna_chance')|0]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. The pope calls a crusade against the Ottomans with vanilla crusade_effect (the pope is also its temporal
# leader). Only for testing .2; phase 3 (.91) will build crusades the design's way.
oe_lat_test_crusade = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PAP country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { exists = international_organization:crusade } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_tt }
        c:PAP = { crusade_effect = { target = scope:oe_lat_tt } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. One former Roman place of an AI Catholic country at peace with us is marked as left behind by a crusade,
# and the buy-back window opens for two years (for testing .3).
oe_lat_test_held = {
    random_country = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = yes
            religion = religion:catholic
            NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
            NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ }
            any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_lat_tw
        random_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region } oe_lat_mark = { who = scope:oe_lat_tw } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_handback years = 2 }
}

# BYZ scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (as oe_mo_auth).
oe_lat_auth = { if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } } }

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps (design 3.6): only while the countries involved are AI; no pop-up, no lock.
# Phase 4 adds P-1, the papacy back in Rome (at the end); phases 5-6 add the northern steps in the marked slots.
oe_lat_world = {
    # W-1 Timur and Smyrna (months 786-828, 25% a month, sure in the last): Smyrna taken from the
    # Latins, or only their harbour castle (the story version).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } var:oe_lat_m >= 786 var:oe_lat_m <= 828 oe_lat_timur_near = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_w1 oe_lat_w1_run = yes } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1n_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_w1 oe_lat_w1n_run = yes } }
    }
    # W-2 after Nicopolis: 9 months after C7's battle (global oe_byd_nicopolis), once.
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } has_variable = oe_lat_nic_m var:oe_lat_nic_m >= 9 }
        oe_lat_w2_run = yes
    }
    # W-3 Alexandria (months 345-354, 35% a month, sure in the last): the fallback while W5 does not run
    # (W5 sets oe_emd_live in its first month; hook E of w5-emd_实施.md).
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_alex_sacked }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_live }
            var:oe_lat_m >= 345 var:oe_lat_m <= 354
            oe_lat_w3_ok = yes
        }
        random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_w3 oe_lat_w3_run = yes }
    }
    # P-1 the papacy back in Rome (phase 4; months 481-495, 100 / months left, sure in the last): a player's
    # or the bloc's Papal States are left alone (3), already in Rome (4); the window passed without the move (2).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_pap_in_rome } var:oe_lat_m >= 481 var:oe_lat_m <= 495 country_exists = c:PAP }
        if = { limit = { c:PAP = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_pap_in_rome value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:PAP = { capital ?= { this = location:rome } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_pap_in_rome value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_p1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_p1 oe_lat_p1_run = yes } }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_pap_in_rome } var:oe_lat_m > 495 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_pap_in_rome value = 2 } }
    # Phase 5: the world steps N-1 to N-4 (design 3.3).
    oe_latn_world5 = yes
    # (phase 6: the world steps N-5 to N-7 go here; design 3.4)
}
# BYZ scope. W-1: Timur takes Smyrna from the Latins (1402.12). It goes back to Aydin (an AI, outside the empire's side;
# Timur restored the emirs), else to the strongest AI Muslim neighbour of Smyrna; else the owner stays. Looted 5 years.
oe_lat_w1_run = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } c:AYD = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_smy_to } }
    else = {
        location:smyrna = {
            ordered_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes religion.group = religion_group:muslim NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
                order_by = oe_lat_owner_army
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_smy_to }
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_smy_to } location:smyrna = { change_location_owner = scope:oe_lat_smy_to } }
    location:smyrna = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } }
    oe_lat_smyrna_falls = { v = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-1: Smyrna has fallen (1) in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. W-1, the story version: only the Latins' harbour castle falls; the town is looted 3 years.
oe_lat_w1n_run = {
    location:smyrna = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    oe_lat_smyrna_falls = { v = 3 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-1: Smyrna has fallen (3) in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
oe_lat_smyrna_falls = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_fell value = $v$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_at value = var:oe_lat_m }
}
# BYZ scope. W-2 after Nicopolis (design 3.6), AI countries only. A defeat: Burgundy ransoms the Count of Nevers (six
# months of its income, at most what it has; prestige -10), Hungary -10, France -5. A victory (C7's global
# oe_byd_nicopolis = 2): Hungary +15, Burgundy +10. Anything else counts as a defeat (the test button, before C7 rolls).
oe_lat_w2_run = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis global_var:oe_byd_nicopolis = 2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = 15 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BUR c:BUR = { is_ai = yes } } c:BUR = { add_prestige = 10 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_ransom value = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BUR c:BUR = { is_ai = yes } }
            c:BUR = {
                save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_ransom }
                add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 }
                add_prestige = -10
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = -10 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FRA c:FRA = { is_ai = yes } } c:FRA = { add_prestige = -5 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_ransom value = 1 }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-2 after Nicopolis ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_world_flags')|0])"
}
# BYZ scope. W-3 Alexandria, the fallback (design 3.6): looted 3 years, the Mamluks' anger at Cyprus, Cyprus +10 prestige.
# The month goes into the global oe_lat_alex_sacked (.4 waits up to 24 months; W5 reads the flag, its hook G).
oe_lat_w3_run = {
    location:alexandria = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_bw_alexandria target = c:CYP } }
    c:CYP = { add_prestige = 10 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_alex_sacked value = var:oe_lat_m }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-3: Alexandria sacked in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}

# BYZ scope. .11 on entry: the battle is rolled (global oe_lat_varna_res: 1 defeat, 2 victory) and the world takes note.
# A victory: the Ottomans get oe_lat_varna_tur, an AI Hungary +15 prestige (the empire's own gains are in the option).
# A defeat: the sultan's wrath if the empire helped (.9 a or b), an AI Hungary -15 and Poland -10 prestige; after .9 a
# the count towards .12 starts.
oe_lat_varna_battle = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_res value = 1 }
    random = { chance = oe_lat_varna_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_res value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res global_var:oe_lat_varna_res = 2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_lat_varna_tur years = 5 mode = replace } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = 15 } }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_lat_varna ?= 1 var:oe_lat_varna ?= 2 } } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_sultan_wrath target = c:BYZ } } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = -15 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_ai = yes } } c:POL = { add_prestige = -10 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_varna ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_hex_m value = 0 } }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_lat Varna: result [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_vres')|0], chance [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_varna_chance')|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. .9 a: a casus belli on the holder of Athens (not the empire's side, not the Ottomans), 10 years; kept in
# oe_lat_athens_cb so that .12 a can give it up again.
oe_lat_athens_cb = {
    location:athens = { owner ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_ath } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_ath scope:oe_lat_ath = { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } NOT = { tag = TUR } } }
        add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_lat_ath type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders years = 10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_athens_cb value = scope:oe_lat_ath }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .12 a: the casus belli of .9 a is given up (if it is still there).
oe_lat_athens_cb_off = {
    var:oe_lat_athens_cb ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_ath }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_ath has_casus_belli_of_type_on = { type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders target = scope:oe_lat_ath } }
        remove_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_lat_ath type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_athens_cb } remove_variable = oe_lat_athens_cb }
}
# BYZ scope. .14 (the wall falls): B5's three steps of oe_mo.7 (the wall torn down, oe_mo_hexamilion gone, the region
# ravaged 5 years, here for our subjects' places too), theme loyalty -10.
oe_lat_hexamilion_fall = {
    location:corinth = { destroy_all_buildings_of_type = building_type:hexamilion_wall }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mo_hexamilion } remove_global_variable = oe_mo_hexamilion }
    oe_lat_morea_mod = { mod = oe_mo_ravaged years = 5 }
    oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -10 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat: the Hexamilion has fallen"
}
# BYZ scope. .12 c: tribute to the sultan (B3's buying-peace agreement), unless one is already in force.
oe_lat_tribute = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
        oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
    }
}

# ---- phase 2 test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. .8 with a fall on record (only the harbour castle, if there is none).
oe_lat_test_8 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_fell value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_at value = oe_ml_month_now }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.8
}
# BYZ scope. .10 (a few ships at .9 if not chosen yet; the Straits and Varna rolled again; .11 follows in 25-40 days).
oe_lat_test_10 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_m value = 12 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.10
}
# BYZ scope. .11 now (the Straits crossed if not rolled yet; Varna rolled again).
oe_lat_test_11 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_straits value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.11
}
# BYZ scope. .12 after a defeat at Varna with the empire's full help (needs Corinth and the wall).
oe_lat_test_12 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_res value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_straits value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.12
}
# BYZ scope. The world steps without their dates (and W-1 without Timur, W-2 without its wait, W-3 without W5's yield);
# every country involved must still be AI.
oe_lat_test_w1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-1 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1_ok = yes } oe_lat_w1_run = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1n_ok = yes } oe_lat_w1n_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-1 cannot run now (Smyrna is not held by an AI Catholic country, and .1 was not answered)" }
}
oe_lat_test_w2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-2 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else = { oe_lat_w2_run = yes }
}
oe_lat_test_w3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_alex_sacked } debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-3 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w3_ok = yes } oe_lat_w3_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-3 cannot run now (a player, a war, or Alexandria not Mamluk)" }
}

# ---- phase 3 (design 3.9)
# BYZ scope (.20 immediate). The pope's seat and the country of the other pope (vanilla's situation variable
# schism_opponent_country, read only); the other one is kept in oe_lat_schism_anti for .21.
oe_lat_schism_scopes = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { capital ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_pcap } } }
    if = {
        limit = { is_situation_active = situation:western_schism }
        situation:western_schism = {
            var:schism_opponent_country ?= { if = { limit = { country_exists = this NOT = { tag = PAP } } save_scope_as = oe_lat_anti } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_anti } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_schism_anti value = scope:oe_lat_anti } }
}
# BYZ scope (.21 immediate). Who won (oe_lat_schism_win: 1 the Papal States' pope, 2 the other) and how the empire's bet
# fared (oe_lat_schism_res: 1 right, 2 wrong, 3 no bet; L4's .4 reads it).
oe_lat_schism_settle = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_schism_win value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_lat_schism_other_won = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_schism_win value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_schism } var:oe_lat_schism ?= 0 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_schism_res value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { AND = { var:oe_lat_schism ?= 1 var:oe_lat_schism_win ?= 1 } AND = { var:oe_lat_schism ?= 2 var:oe_lat_schism_win ?= 2 } } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_schism_res value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_schism_res value = 2 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .21: the embassy to the council of the West (global oe_lat_constance_envoys: L4's .4 follows it); before
# 1416.1.1 it waits for that day (oe_lat_envoys_due, the bookkeeping sends it).
oe_lat_send_envoys = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_envoys value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { current_date >= 1416.1.1 } oe_lat_envoys_go = yes }
    else = { set_variable = oe_lat_envoys_due }
}
oe_lat_envoys_go = { set_global_variable = oe_lat_constance_envoys }

# BYZ scope. The Pillars action oe_lat_act_appeal (遣使罗马，请求十字军): its costs, 15 years' cooldown, and .23
# to the Papal States in 30 days.
oe_lat_appeal_send = {
    oe_lat_pay = { months = 2 }
    oe_lat_auth = { amount = -5 }
    add_prestige = -5
    oe_ecc_shift = { hes = -3 rat = 0 uni = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_cd years = 15 }
    set_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_fail } remove_variable = oe_lat_fail }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_appeal_n } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_n add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_n value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_lat.23 days = 30 } } }
}
# BYZ scope. The pope's answer $r$ (.23: 1 a crusade, 2 indulgences, 3 union first, 4 nothing); .22 follows in 20-40 days.
oe_lat_answer = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_res value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait } remove_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_lat.22 days = { 20 40 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .23 b: the money of the indulgences, four months of our income; an AI Papal States pay it (at most what
# they have), a player's are not charged. Paid out at .22 (oe_lat_indulg).
oe_lat_indulgence = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PAP c:PAP = { is_ai = yes } }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_pap_pays }
        c:PAP = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_indulg value = scope:oe_lat_amt }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_indulg value = oe_lat_m4 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .22: the answer is dealt with (oe_lat_appeal_last keeps it for the readouts).
oe_lat_appeal_close = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_appeal_res } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_last value = var:oe_lat_appeal_res } }
    remove_variable = oe_lat_appeal_res
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_indulg } remove_variable = oe_lat_indulg }
}
# Any scope (the worker .91 of the Papal States). The pope calls the crusade on the Ottomans, the way vanilla's Holy
# League event builds one (flavor_pap_holy_league.1): the organisation with the Ottomans as target and the Papal States
# as leader; the target place (crusade_location_target) the Ottomans' most developed place in a theme region, else
# their capital; the temporal leader the strongest Catholic neighbour of the Ottomans that could join (a Catholic empire
# if there is none). Other members join by vanilla's own rules. Self-check (no debug_log: a command reaches this): the
# organisation must stand with the Ottomans as target, else failure code oe_lat_fail (1 not built, 2 a crusade was
# already there) and the answer becomes "nothing" (4). The one place to change if the engine wants another form.
oe_lat_make_crusade = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PAP country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { exists = international_organization:crusade } }
        c:TUR = {
            save_scope_as = oe_lat_ct
            ordered_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region } order_by = development save_scope_as = oe_lat_cloc }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_lat_cloc } } capital ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_cloc } }
            ordered_neighbor_country = { limit = { oe_lat_cru_leader_ok = yes } order_by = country_strength save_scope_as = oe_lat_cl }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_lat_cl } country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { religion = religion:catholic } }
            c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_cl }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_cloc } set_global_variable = { name = crusade_location_target value = scope:oe_lat_cloc } }
        create_international_organization = {
            type = international_organization_type:crusade
            target = scope:oe_lat_ct
            add_country_to_international_organization = c:PAP
            set_leader_country = c:PAP
            save_scope_as = oe_lat_cio
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_cl exists = scope:oe_lat_cio }
            scope:oe_lat_cio = {
                add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_lat_cl
                international_organization_add_special_status = { type = special_status:crusade_temporal_leader country = scope:oe_lat_cl }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = international_organization:crusade international_organization:crusade = { international_organization_target ?= { tag = TUR } } }
            set_global_variable = oe_lat_crusade_ours
            c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = oe_lat_cru_seen }
        }
        else = { oe_lat_crusade_failed = { code = 1 } }
    }
    else = { oe_lat_crusade_failed = { code = 2 } }
}
oe_lat_crusade_failed = {
    c:BYZ ?= {
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fail value = $code$ }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_appeal_res ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_res value = 4 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The phase-3 debug_log line (test button lw3log only, with the two earlier lines).
oe_lat_log3 = { oe_lat_log = yes debug_log = "oe_lat3 schism=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_schism')|0] sres=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_sres')|0] ev3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_ev3')|0] appeal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_appeal')|0] flags3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_flags3')|0] papal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_papal_auth')|0] ai23a=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_ai_23a')|0] will=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_west_will')|0]" }

# ---- phase 3 test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. .21 without the schism (seen recorded if missing); the bet made at .20 decides the text, as in play.
oe_lat_test_21 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_schism_seen } } set_global_variable = oe_lat_schism_seen }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_21 } remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_21 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.21
}
# BYZ scope. The action's effect without its costs and conditions: .23 goes to the Papal States now (an AI answers; .22
# follows in 20-40 days).
oe_lat_test_appeal = {
    set_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.23 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .23 shown to the current player, who answers for the pope (every effect names c:PAP).
oe_lat_test_23 = {
    set_variable = oe_lat_appeal_wait
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.23
}
# BYZ scope. The worker .91 builds the crusade now (vanilla's rules on the target's rank are not checked here).
oe_lat_test_cru = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_fail } remove_variable = oe_lat_fail }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { trigger_event_silently = oe_lat.91 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .22 with the answer $r$ (2: the money is four months of our income; 1 needs a crusade, else it reads 4).
oe_lat_test_22 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_appeal_res value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_appeal_res ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_indulg value = oe_lat_m4 } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.22
}

# ---- phase 4 (design 3.2)
# BYZ scope (oe_lat_world). P-1: the papacy back in Rome, vanilla's own form (western_schism.txt moves the Papal States'
# capital the same way when the schism ends).
oe_lat_p1_run = {
    c:PAP = { set_capital = location:rome }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_pap_in_rome value = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step P-1: the papacy is back in Rome in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# Any scope (L4's .10 calls it in the empire's scope). The empire's side between the pope's council at Ferrara and the
# Council of Basel, $side$ = pope or basel. L4 (gen_union.py, branch switch D4_SIDE) looks for the literal name of this
# effect at the start of a line: once it is in the mod, .10 calls it instead of adding its own opinions (no double count).
oe_lat_council_side = {
    oe_lat_council_side_$side$ = yes
}
# The pope: the papacy +20 (10 years), papal authority +3.
oe_lat_council_side_pope = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_council_pope target = c:BYZ } } }
    change_papal_authority = { value = 3 }
    c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_council value = 1 } }
}
# Basel: the papacy -20 (10 years), papal authority -5, Savoy (the house of Felix V) +10 (5 years).
oe_lat_council_side_basel = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_council_basel target = c:BYZ } } }
    subtract_papal_authority = { value = 5 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SAV } c:SAV = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_council_savoy target = c:BYZ } } }
    c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_council value = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope. The phase-4 debug_log line (test buttons lw4* only, with the three earlier lines).
oe_lat_log4 = { oe_lat_log3 = yes debug_log = "oe_lat4 ev4=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_ev4')|0] prome=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_prome')|0] papop=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_papop')|0] savop=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_savop')|0] papal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_papal_auth')|0] world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_world_flags')|0]" }

# ---- phase 4 test buttons only (DEV_LINES)

# Rome not a capital, no schism); then the readouts.
oe_lat_test_p1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_pap_in_rome } debug_log = "oe_lat test: P-1 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_p1_ok = yes } oe_lat_p1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: P-1 cannot run now (the Papal States a player or in the bloc, Rome not theirs or already a capital, or the schism running)" }
    oe_lat_log4 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The council effect with $side$, then the readouts.
oe_lat_test_cs = {
    oe_lat_council_side = { side = $side$ }
    oe_lat_log4 = yes
}

# ---- phase 5 (design 3.3)
# BYZ scope, monthly (from oe_lat_world). The world steps N-1 to N-4; the countries involved must be AI and outside the
# empire's bloc (global oe_latn_ws_<n>: 1 done, 2 the window passed, 3 skipped).
oe_latn_world5 = {
    # N-1 baptism from the East: after .30 a (oe_latn_east_try = 1), months 6-24 after it and never after
    # month 606; one roll as soon as its conditions hold in the window.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_latn_east_try ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_1 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_latn_n1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_1 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_m > oe_latn_n1_end } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_1 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_m >= oe_latn_n1_from oe_latn_n1_ok = yes } oe_latn_n1_run = yes }
    }
    # N-2 the Peace of Thorn (months 884-900).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_2 } var:oe_lat_m >= 884 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_m > 900 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_2 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n2_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_2 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n2_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_latn_ch_2 oe_latn_n2_run = yes } }
    }
    # N-3 the Samogitians baptised (months 923-984).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_3 } var:oe_lat_m >= 923 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_m > 984 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_3 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n3_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_3 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n3_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_latn_ch_3 oe_latn_n3_run = yes } }
    }
    # N-4 Melno (months 1029-1044): nothing left in the Order's hands is recorded as done at once.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_4 } var:oe_lat_m >= 1029 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_m > 1044 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_4 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n4_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_4 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n4_none = yes } oe_latn_n4_nothing = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n4_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_latn_ch_4 oe_latn_n4_run = yes } }
    }
}
# Any scope. N-1's hit: Lithuania, its ruler and the ruler's family become Orthodox. The set of effects is vanilla
# flavor_lit.8's (change_religion, change_religion_for_ruler_and_family, the ruler and the ruler's children), with
# Orthodoxy for Catholicism and bound to c:LIT explicitly (The Reich's rfe_original_lit_conversion does the same for its
# own caller); vanilla's Catholic opinions and modifiers are not given.
oe_latn_convert_east = {
    c:LIT = { change_religion = religion:orthodox }
    change_religion_for_ruler_and_family = { country = c:LIT religion = religion:orthodox }
    c:LIT = { ruler ?= { change_character_religion = religion:orthodox every_child = { change_character_religion = religion:orthodox } } }
}
# BYZ scope. N-1: one roll (oe_latn_east_chance). A hit: the conversion, D2's see of Lithuania in our care (1), Moscow
# and Lithuania +20 each other (10 years).
oe_latn_n1_run = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_east value = 2 }
    random = { chance = oe_latn_east_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_east value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_east global_var:oe_latn_east = 1 }
        oe_latn_convert_east = yes
        oe_ecc_see_set = { see = lit value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:MOS c:MOS = { is_ai = yes } }
            c:MOS = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_latn_b_east_kin target = c:LIT } }
            c:LIT = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_latn_b_east_kin target = c:MOS } }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step N-1: baptism from the East [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_flags')|0] (chance [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_east_chance')|0]) in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. N-2: the roll (oe_latn_n2_chance). The Order beaten: the Peace of Thorn. Stalemate: Poland and Lithuania
# -15 to the Order (10 years), nothing else.
oe_latn_n2_run = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_2 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_thorn value = 2 }
    random = { chance = oe_latn_n2_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_thorn value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_thorn global_var:oe_latn_thorn = 1 } oe_latn_thorn_peace = yes }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_ai = yes } } c:POL = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_latn_b_thorn_unsettled target = c:TEU } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { is_ai = yes } } c:LIT = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_latn_b_thorn_unsettled target = c:TEU } } }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step N-2: Thorn [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_flags')|0] (chance [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_n2_chance')|0]), places moved [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_moved').GetValue|0], fail [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_fail').GetValue|0] in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. The Peace of Thorn (1411): the Order's places in Samogitia to Lithuania, in Dobrzyn to Poland; half of
# min(treasury, twelve months' income) to each; the indemnity modifier 10 years; prestige +10 each; truces 10 years.
oe_latn_thorn_peace = {
    # fix-g1222 item 16 (r23 g20: 3 places handed over, readout moved=0): change_variable does nothing to a variable that
    # was never set (error.log "oe_latn_moved is used but is never set"), so each step's count starts at 0 here.
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_moved value = 0 }
    oe_latn_cede_samogitia = yes
    oe_latn_cede_dobrzyn = yes
    c:TEU = {
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_latn_amt value = oe_latn_thorn_half }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_latn_amt multiply = -2 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_latn_thorn_debt years = 10 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:POL } } add_truce_with = { target = c:POL years = 10 mutual = yes } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:LIT } } add_truce_with = { target = c:LIT years = 10 mutual = yes } }
        c:POL = { add_gold = scope:oe_latn_amt add_prestige = 10 }
        c:LIT = { add_gold = scope:oe_latn_amt add_prestige = 10 }
    }
}
oe_latn_cede_samogitia = {
    area:samogitia_area = { every_location_in_area = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:TEU } add_to_temporary_list = oe_latn_to_lit } }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_latn_to_lit
        limit = { owner ?= c:TEU controller ?= c:TEU has_siege = no is_capital = no }
        change_location_owner = c:LIT change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:LIT } root = { change_variable = { name = oe_latn_moved add = 1 } } }
        else = { root = { set_variable = { name = oe_latn_fail value = 1 } } }
    }
}
oe_latn_cede_dobrzyn = {
    province_definition:dobrzyn_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:TEU } add_to_temporary_list = oe_latn_to_pol } }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_latn_to_pol
        limit = { owner ?= c:TEU controller ?= c:TEU has_siege = no is_capital = no }
        change_location_owner = c:POL change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:POL } root = { change_variable = { name = oe_latn_moved add = 1 } } }
        else = { root = { set_variable = { name = oe_latn_fail value = 1 } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. N-3: Lithuania gets oe_latn_samogitia 10 years; an AI Poland +10 to Lithuania.
oe_latn_n3_run = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_3 value = 1 }
    c:LIT = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_latn_samogitia years = 10 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_ai = yes } } c:POL = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_latn_b_samogitia target = c:LIT } } }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step N-3: the Samogitians baptised in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. N-4 Melno (1422): what the Order still holds in Samogitia goes to Lithuania; truce 10 years.
oe_latn_n4_run = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_4 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_melno value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_moved value = 0 }
    oe_latn_cede_samogitia = yes
    c:TEU = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:LIT } } add_truce_with = { target = c:LIT years = 10 mutual = yes } } }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step N-4: Melno, places moved [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_moved').GetValue|0], fail [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_fail').GetValue|0] in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. N-4 with nothing left in the Order's hands (Thorn or the AI's own wars settled it): recorded as done.
oe_latn_n4_nothing = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_ws_4 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_latn_melno value = 2 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step N-4: Melno, nothing left to hand over in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}

# BYZ scope. Counts for the readout: Samogitia's places held by the Order / Lithuania, Dobrzyn's by the Order / Poland.
oe_latn_count = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_st value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_sl value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_dt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_dp value = 0 }
    area:samogitia_area = { every_location_in_area = {
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TEU } root = { change_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_st add = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:LIT } root = { change_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_sl add = 1 } } }
    } }
    province_definition:dobrzyn_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = {
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TEU } root = { change_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_dt add = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:POL } root = { change_variable = { name = oe_latn_n_dp add = 1 } } }
    } }
}
# BYZ scope. The phase-5 debug_log line (test buttons lw5* only, with the four earlier lines).
oe_lat_log5 = { oe_lat_log4 = yes oe_latn_count = yes debug_log = "oe_lat5 ev5=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_rd_ev5')|0] ws=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_rd_ws')|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_flags')|0] east%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_east_chance')|0] thorn%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_n2_chance')|0] litrel=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_rd_litrel')|0] see=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_rd_see')|0] samo_teu=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_n_st').GetValue|0] samo_lit=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_n_sl').GetValue|0] dob_teu=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_n_dt').GetValue|0] dob_pol=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_n_dp').GetValue|0] teug=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_latn_rd_teug')|0] moved=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_moved').GetValue|0] fail=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_latn_fail').GetValue|0]" }

# ---- phase 5 test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. N-1 now with the roll forced ($r$: 1 sure, 2 never), without its window; .30 a counts as chosen. The other
# conditions hold (an AI Lithuania outside the bloc, not Christian, the marriage chain not begun, no war with Moscow).
oe_latn_test_n1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_east_try value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_latn_east_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_latn_east_m value = oe_ml_month_now } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_force value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_1 } debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-1 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n1_ok = yes } oe_latn_n1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-1 cannot run now (Lithuania gone, a player, in the bloc or Christian; Poland's marriage chain begun; or at war with Moscow)" }
    remove_variable = oe_latn_force
    oe_lat_log5 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. N-2 now with the roll forced ($r$: 1 the Order beaten, 2 stalemate), without its window, its wars, Lithuania's
# faith or the Polish-Lithuanian bond; the three must still be AI and outside the bloc.
oe_latn_test_n2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_latn_force value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_2 } debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-2 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n2_ai = yes } oe_latn_n2_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-2 cannot run now (the Teutons, Poland or Lithuania gone, a player or in the bloc)" }
    remove_variable = oe_latn_force
    oe_lat_log5 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. N-3 and N-4 now, without their windows (N-3 without Lithuania's faith and the count of places, N-4 without the
# war); the countries must still be AI and outside the bloc.
oe_latn_test_n34 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_3 } debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-3 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n3_ai = yes } oe_latn_n3_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-3 cannot run now (Lithuania gone, a player or in the bloc)" }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_ws_4 } debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-4 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n4_none = yes } oe_latn_n4_nothing = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_latn_n4_ai = yes } oe_latn_n4_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: N-4 cannot run now (the Teutons or Lithuania gone, a player or in the bloc)" }
    oe_lat_log5 = yes
}
